sql.attachment.getAttachmentById: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE a.id = :id AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsByType: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id INNER JOIN flow.attachment_type at ON at.id = a.attachment_type_id WHERE a.id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentBySourceAndType: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE LIMIT 1
sql.attachment.getAttachmentsBySourceIdAndTy: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, src.source_id, a.archived FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id INNER JOIN flow.attachment_type at ON at.id = a.attachment_type_id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND at.id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived IS NOT TRUE
sql.attachment.getAttachmentBySourceAndTypeF: SELECT a.id, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.filename, a.s3_key, a.size, a.archived, src.source_id, a.date_created, a.date_modified FROM flow.attachment a INNER JOIN flow.attachment_source src ON src.attachment_id = a.id INNER JOIN flow.attachment_type at ON at.id = a.attachment_type_id WHERE array[src.source_id] <@ ARRAY[ :sourceIds ]::INTEGER[] AND at.id = :attachmentTypeId AND a.archived is not true
sql.attachment.create: INSERT INTO flow.attachment(filename, content_type, s3_key, size, date_created, created_by_id, attachment_type_id, company_id) VALUES(:filename, :contentType, :key, :size, now(), :createdById, :attachmentTypeId, :companyId)
sql.attachment.deleteById: UPDATE flow.attachment SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE id = :id
sql.attachment.deleteBySourceAndType: UPDATE flow.attachment a SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById FROM ( SELECT src.attachment_id FROM flow.attachment_source src inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = src.attachment_id WHERE src.source_id = :sourceId AND a.attachment_type_id = :attachmentTypeId ) AS s WHERE a.id = s.attachment_id
sql.attachment.getAttachmentType: select at.id, at.attachment_type, at.is_system, at.key_pattern_id, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where at.id = :id
